name: Darier病

summary.text: A rare, genetic keratinization disorder which is classically characterized by keratotic papules, acral pits, and acral wart-like lesions that can be associated with a trigger, and may occur anywhere on the body (including mucosal surfaces). Extracutaneous manifestations may include, nail anomalies, blepharitis, dry eye, neuropsychiatric illness and, recurrent parotid gland obstruction and xerostomia.
